title: 1. Scope and Applicability
body:
This Website Policy, Rules & User Conduct Standards (“Policy”) governs all access to and use of the Rental City website, mobile application, and related services (“Platform”). This Policy applies to all users, including:
• Tenants and rental applicants (“Tenants”)
• Landlords and property managers (“Landlords”)
• Any individual or entity accessing the Platform (“User”)
By using the Platform, User agrees to comply with this Policy.

title: 2. Eligibility and Account Requirements
body:
2.1 Accurate Information Users must provide true, accurate, and complete information when creating an account, submitting applications, or posting listings.
2.2 Account Security Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login credentials and for all activity under their account.
2.3 Prohibited Users Users may not access or use the Platform if they:
• Provide false or fraudulent information
• Impersonate another person or entity
• Have been previously suspended or removed by Rental City

title: 3. Prohibited Conduct
body:
Users are strictly prohibited from:
• Posting false, misleading, or fraudulent information
• Harassing, threatening, or abusing other Users
• Attempting to bypass verification or screening processes
• Scraping, harvesting, or copying Platform data
• Uploading malware or interfering with Platform operations
• Using the Platform for unlawful or deceptive purposes
• Engaging in discriminatory conduct in violation of fair housing laws
Rental City may suspend or terminate accounts for violations.

title: 4. Fair Housing and Anti Discrimination Compliance
body:
4.1 Mandatory Compliance All Users must comply with:
• The Federal Fair Housing Act
• The Civil Rights Act
• The Americans with Disabilities Act
• All state and local fair housing laws
4.2 Prohibited Discrimination Users may not discriminate based on:
• Race
• Color
• National origin
• Religion
• Sex
• Familial status
• Disability
• Any additional protected class under state or local law
4.3 Listing Review Rental City may remove or modify any listing that contains discriminatory or unlawful content.

title: 5. Data Privacy and Information Use
body:
5.1 Privacy Policy User agrees to Rental City’s Privacy Policy, which governs the collection, storage, and use of personal information.
5.2 Prohibited Data Use Users may not:
• Sell, share, or misuse personal information obtained through the Platform
• Use Tenant or Landlord data for marketing or unrelated business purposes
• Attempt to access information they are not authorized to view
5.3 Security Measures Rental City implements reasonable safeguards to protect User data but cannot guarantee absolute security.

title: 6. Screening and Application Rules
body:
6.1 Tenant Consent Tenants must provide explicit consent before any screening is performed.
6.2 Landlord Responsibilities Landlords must:
• Use screening information solely for evaluating tenancy
• Issue adverse action notices when required by law
• Not use protected characteristics in screening decisions
6.3 Rental City’s Role Rental City facilitates screening but does not:
• Approve or deny applicants
• Guarantee screening outcomes
• Make leasing decisions

title: 7. Listing and Property Requirements
body:
Landlords must ensure that:
• All property information is accurate and truthful
• Pricing, availability, and terms are current
• Photos and descriptions reflect the actual property
• Listings comply with fair housing and advertising laws
Rental City may remove listings that violate these rules.

title: 8. Communication Standards
body:
Users must:
• Communicate respectfully and professionally
• Avoid harassment, threats, or abusive language
• Use the Platform only for legitimate rental related communication
Rental City may monitor communications for compliance and safety.

title: 9. Fraud Prevention and Verification
body:
Rental City may conduct:
• Identity verification
• Ownership verification
• Fraud and risk assessments
• Monitoring for suspicious activity
Users agree to cooperate with verification requests.

title: 10. Intellectual Property
body: All Platform content, including software, text, graphics, logos, and databases, is the property of Rental City and may not be copied, modified, or distributed without written permission.

title: 11. Liability Disclaimer (Updated With $0 Maximum Liability)
body:
11.1 No Liability for User Conduct Rental City is a technology platform that facilitates communication, matching, and screening. Rental City does not control or supervise User actions. Rental City shall not be held liable for:
• Any acts, omissions, misconduct, negligence, fraud, or wrongdoing by Users
• Any disputes, damages, losses, or injuries arising from rental transactions
• Any statements, representations, or information provided by Users
11.2 No Liability for Property Conditions or Lease Terms Rental City does not own, manage, inspect, or maintain rental properties. Rental City shall not be liable for:
• Property conditions or safety issues
• Lease terms, rent amounts, deposits, or fees
• Repairs, maintenance, or landlord obligations
• Tenant behavior or lease compliance
11.3 No Liability for Screening Outcomes Rental City does not guarantee:
• Accuracy of screening results
• Approval or denial of applications
• Completeness of User submitted documents
11.4 No Liability for Data Misuse by Users Rental City is not responsible for:
• Misuse or unauthorized sharing of personal information by Users
• Breaches caused by User actions
• Damages arising from User to User communication
11.5 Platform Availability Rental City shall not be liable for:
• Downtime, outages, or technical failures
• Loss of data due to system errors
• Delays caused by third party services
11.6 Maximum Liability = $0 To the fullest extent permitted by law, Rental City’s total liability for any claim is $0.
11.7 Assumption of Risk Users acknowledge that all rental interactions involve inherent risks and agree to use the Platform at their own risk.

title: 12. Enforcement and Account Actions
body:
Rental City may, at its discretion:
• Suspend or terminate accounts
• Remove or modify listings
• Restrict access to Platform features
• Report unlawful activity to authorities

title: 13. Modifications to This Policy
body: Rental City may update this Policy at any time. Continued use of the Platform constitutes acceptance of all updates.
